author: aa_juggernaut
body:
When appealing for a temp-ban/ban on the Avicus Network, please include the following: 
  • Your minecraft username (most recent name if changed)
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.
aa_juggernaut
I was banned for flying
I should be unbanned because i never meant to use it to actually cheat, i just wanted to check out the map since it had been a while since i played. I let the people at the monument kill me before i mined it. Also, my brother and sister really want me to play with them(Junior_juggernaut) mostly my bro though.

title: appealing for an infraction

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,

I would suggest that you wait a few months before creating an appeal, unless you are able to prove that were not hacking. Otherwise, your chances of being unbanned will be low as your ban time will not be sufficient. Therefore, your appeal is denied for now.

Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Senior Moderator
